title: Reeds, mouthpieces and the Albert system clarinet
summary: Hall describes using medium reeds, only three mouthpieces in his life, and always playing the Albert system.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Well, how hard a reed do you use?
Well, I'm using a lavas, I'm using a medium hard.
And in the old age, did you use very hard or something?
No, well, in the old days, you know, it's not like, all your reads now, practically the number now, you see. The old days, you just had to pick out until you get a good one.
And did you try for a hard one or a soft one?
Yeah. Did you do anything until you read? No. What you got?
Well, to be frankly, I only used three mouthpieces in my whole life, since I've been playing.
Just leave it. Just leave it just a while. You buy them open now or close, see. So, do you still use Albert? Albert's system kind. You always did use Albert?
